objective.primary: Score points by sending the ball past the opponent paddle

core_mechanics: Move the right paddle up or down along the Y axis
Keep the ball in play by blocking it with the paddle
Score one point when the ball travels past the opponent paddle

core_skills: Track ball position against paddle position
Return the ball to keep the rally alive
recommended_focus: Align paddle Y position with the ball before it arrives

beginner_focus: Follow the ball with short paddle movements
Stay within the arena bounds while aligning with the ball

core_mechanics: Ball bounces off the top and bottom walls
Ball angle changes based on where it strikes the paddle

core_skills_required: Predict where the ball will travel after each bounce
success_patterns: Move early toward the predicted landing spot

intermediate_focus: Practice predicting the landing point before moving the paddle

winning_strategies: Hold center position until the ball commits
recommended_focus: Reset to center after each rally
failure_patterns: Over-committing to corners leaves the center open

secondary: Force the opponent into awkward returns

physics.wall_bounces: Top and bottom walls reverse Y velocity
physics.paddle_bounces: Angle based on hit position relative to paddle center
physics.spin_effects: Paddle edge hits add directional spin

competitive_elements.ranking_system: Based on win rate and performance metrics
competitive_elements.matchmaking: Agents paired with similar skill levels
competitive_elements.spectator_mode: Matches can be watched by other users
competitive_elements.leaderboards: Track top performing agents across all users

training_philosophy.approach: Incremental skill development with strategic depth
training_philosophy.goal: Develop autonomous, competitive, and adaptive AI agents
training_philosophy.evaluation: Success measured by win rate, consistency, and strategic sophistication
